message.en-US: The request signature could not be verified. Retry. If this continues, update the app or report the issue.
message.zh-CN: 本次请求的签名校验未通过。请重试；如持续出现，请更新客户端或提交反馈。

message.en-US: The request timestamp could not be verified. Check your device clock, update the app, and retry.
message.zh-CN: 本次请求的时间校验未通过。请检查设备时间是否准确，更新客户端后重试。

message.en-US: This request has already been received. Avoid sending it again. If no response arrives, retry later.
message.zh-CN: 本次请求已被接收，请勿重复发送。若仍未获得回复，可稍后重试。

message.en-US: This account has no trial allowance or access entitlement. Check your account status or contact support.
message.zh-CN: 当前账户未获得试用额度或访问资格。请检查账户状态，或联系支持人员处理。

message.en-US: Your login has expired. Please log in again to continue.
message.zh-CN: 您的登录状态已过期，请重新登录以继续使用。

message.en-US: Your current IP address is not allowed by your organization. Use an allowed network or contact an administrator.
message.zh-CN: 当前网络 IP 不在组织允许的范围内。请切换到允许的网络，或联系管理员处理。

message.en-US: This account has no available license. Contact an administrator to assign a license, then retry.
message.zh-CN: 当前账户未获得可用许可证。请联系管理员分配许可证后重试。

message.en-US: Your organization has disabled this application. Contact an administrator to enable it, then retry.
message.zh-CN: 组织已禁用此应用。请联系管理员启用后重试。

message.en-US: You have used up today's request quota. Please try again tomorrow.
message.zh-CN: 您今天的请求次数已达到上限，请明天再试。

message.en-US: This account has used its available quota. Check the quota status and add quota or wait for it to become available before retrying.
message.zh-CN: 当前账户的可用额度已用尽。请检查额度状态，补充额度或等待额度恢复后重试。

message.en-US: This account has insufficient available Credits. Check usage, add credits, or adjust your subscription plan before retrying.
message.zh-CN: 当前账户的可用 Credits 不足。请查看用量，补充额度或调整订阅计划后重试。

title.zh-CN: 当前请求受到使用限制

message.en-US: This request is limited by model usage or request rate. Retry later or switch to another model.
message.zh-CN: 当前请求受到模型用量或访问频率限制。请稍后重试，或切换其他模型。

message.en-US: Trial account usage on this device is restricted. Review the account restrictions or contact support.
message.zh-CN: 当前设备的试用账户使用受到限制。请检查账户限制说明，或联系支持人员处理。

title.zh-CN: 轻量模型月度额度已用尽

message.en-US: You've reached your monthly Lite model limit. Upgrade your subscription plan to continue, or check the FAQ for details.
message.zh-CN: 您已达到轻量模型的每月使用上限。升级订阅计划后可继续使用，也可以查看 FAQ 文档了解详情。

message.en-US: You have reached your quota limit. It will reset in the next billing cycle. Visit our website for more credits.
message.zh-CN: 您已达到配额上限，将在下个订阅周期自动重置。可访问官网增购更多资源。

message.en-US: You have reached your quota limit. It will reset in the next billing cycle. Contact your admin for more credits, or view usage details on our website.
message.zh-CN: 您已达到配额上限，将在下个订阅周期自动重置。可联系管理员增购更多资源，或访问官网查看用量详情。

message.en-US: This account has insufficient available Credits. Check usage, add credits, or adjust your subscription plan before retrying.
message.zh-CN: 当前账户的可用 Credits 不足。请查看用量，补充额度或调整订阅计划后重试。

message.en-US: You have used up today's free quota for this model. Please try again tomorrow.
message.zh-CN: 您今天在当前免费模型上的可用额度已用尽，请明天再试。

message.en-US: This account’s data has been migrated and is unavailable through the current entry point. Contact support to confirm how to access it.
message.zh-CN: 当前账户的数据已迁移，暂时无法通过当前入口继续使用。请联系支持人员确认新的访问方式。

message.en-US: Your organization’s data has been migrated and is unavailable through the current entry point. Ask an administrator how to access it.
message.zh-CN: 当前组织的数据已迁移，暂时无法通过当前入口继续使用。请联系管理员确认新的访问方式。

message.en-US: Your billing group has reached its Credits limit for this billing cycle. Ask an administrator to adjust the limit, or retry after it resets in the next cycle.
message.zh-CN: 当前计费组的 Credits 已达到本账期限额。请联系管理员调整额度，或在下个账期重置后重试。

message.en-US: Plan credits are unavailable during your organization’s plan upgrade, and resource pack credits are insufficient. Ask an administrator to check the upgrade status or add resource pack credits, then retry.
message.zh-CN: 组织套餐升级期间暂时无法使用套餐额度，且资源包额度不足。请联系管理员确认升级状态或补充资源包额度后重试。

message.en-US: A system or model error interrupted this request. Retry later. If this continues, report the issue.
message.zh-CN: 本次请求遇到系统或模型异常。请稍后重试；如持续出现，请提交反馈。

title.en-US: I can't continue this topic right now
title.zh-CN: 这个话题我暂时聊不了

message.en-US: Start a new task to talk about something else.
message.zh-CN: 新建任务换个话题继续吧~

message.en-US: This app version no longer supports this capability. Update the app and retry.
message.zh-CN: 当前版本已不支持此能力。请更新客户端后重试。

message.en-US: The request is too large. Reduce the input or attachment size, or split the work into smaller requests, then retry.
message.zh-CN: 本次请求的内容过大。请减少输入或附件大小，必要时分批处理后重试。

title.en-US: The current model declined this request
title.zh-CN: 当前模型拒绝了本次请求

message.en-US: Try switching models or starting a new task, then retry.
message.zh-CN: 请尝试切换模型，或新建任务后重试。

message.en-US: The response could not be received completely. Retry. If this continues, check your connection or report the issue.
message.zh-CN: 本次回复未能完整接收。请重试；如持续出现，请检查网络或提交反馈。

message.en-US: The service is temporarily limiting requests due to high traffic. Retry later.
message.zh-CN: 当前请求量较大，服务暂时限流。请稍后重试。

message.en-US: This feature is not supported in the current version. Please update to the latest version and try again.
message.zh-CN: 当前版本暂不支持此能力，请升级到最新版本后重试。

message.en-US: Please try again. If the issue persists, you can report it via the feedback button in the bottom-right corner.
message.zh-CN: 请重试。如问题持续存在，可点击右下角反馈按钮向我们报告。

message.en-US: This request timed out, possibly due to network instability or a slow service response. Please try again.
message.zh-CN: 本次请求超时，可能是网络波动或服务响应过慢导致。请稍后重试。

message.en-US: Please try again later. If the issue persists, you can report it via the feedback button in the bottom-right corner.
message.zh-CN: 请稍后重试。如问题持续存在，可点击右下角反馈按钮向我们报告。

message.en-US: The model is currently under heavy load. Please wait a moment and try again, or switch to a different model.
message.zh-CN: 当前模型负载较高，请稍等片刻后重试，或切换到其他模型使用。

message.en-US: This task reached the task turn limit. Please start a new task or narrow the request and try again.
message.zh-CN: 当前任务的轮次已达到上限。请新建任务，或缩小问题范围后重试。

message.en-US: This response was stopped because it reached the output length limit. Please narrow the request and try again.
message.zh-CN: 本次回答因长度限制被中止，请缩小问题范围后重试。

message.en-US: This task reached the tool call limit. Please narrow the scope of work and try again.
message.zh-CN: 本次任务的工具调用次数已达到上限。请缩小工作范围后重试。

message.en-US: The current network proxy configuration could not establish a connection. Please check your local proxy settings and try again.
message.zh-CN: 当前网络代理配置无法建立连接，请检查本地代理设置后重试。

title.zh-CN: 当前模型不支持此能力

message.en-US: The current model does not support this request. Please switch to another model and try again.
message.zh-CN: 当前模型不支持执行该请求，请切换到其他模型后重试。

message.en-US: Your free account currently has no available credits. If you are a new user, please wait 3-5 minutes for trial credits to be issued. To access the service immediately or obtain additional credits, please upgrade your subscription plan.
message.zh-CN: 您的免费账户暂无可用额度。如是新用户，请耐心等待试用 Credits 发放，预计耗时 3-5 分钟；如需立即使用或获得更多额度，可升级订阅计划。

message.en-US: This repository is restricted by a security policy, and the current model cannot be used. Please switch models, or contact your administrator to review the policy.
message.zh-CN: 当前仓库触发了安全策略，暂不支持使用该模型。请切换到其他模型，或联系管理员确认策略。

message.en-US: To unblock the call, review and adjust the corresponding Hook file, then retry.
message.zh-CN: 如需解除阻止，请检查并调整对应的 Hook 文件后重试。

message.en-US: This task has exceeded the model's context limit. Please start a new task, or narrow the request and try again.
message.zh-CN: 当前任务内容已超过模型可处理范围。请新建任务，或缩小问题范围后重试。

title.zh-CN: 媒体文件数量超出限制

message.en-US: This request contains too many media files. Reduce the number of images or documents, or process them in smaller batches, then retry.
message.zh-CN: 单次请求中的媒体文件过多。请减少图片或文档数量，分批处理后重试。

message.en-US: The current model does not support image input. Please switch to another model and try again.
message.zh-CN: 当前模型不支持图片输入，请切换到其他模型重试。

message.en-US: The custom model service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later, or switch to another model.
message.zh-CN: 自定义模型服务暂时不可用，请稍后重试，或切换到其他模型继续。

message.en-US: Authentication for the custom model failed. Please check whether the API key and related configuration are correct.
message.zh-CN: 自定义模型认证失败，请检查 API Key 或相关配置是否正确。

title.en-US: Custom model unavailable on this plan
title.zh-CN: 当前套餐不支持自定义模型

message.en-US: Your current plan does not support custom models. Switch to another model or check your plan’s permissions before retrying.
message.zh-CN: 当前套餐暂不支持使用自定义模型。请切换其他模型，或检查套餐权限后重试。

message.en-US: The phone number required for this external model could not be retrieved. Check your account's linked phone number and retry, or select another model.
message.zh-CN: 暂时无法获取使用外部模型所需的手机号。检查账号绑定信息后重试，或选择其他模型。

message.en-US: The phone number required for this external model could not be retrieved. Check your account's linked phone number and retry, or select another model.
message.zh-CN: 暂时无法获取使用外部模型所需的手机号。检查账号绑定信息后重试，或选择其他模型。

title.zh-CN: 外部模型服务暂不可用

message.en-US: This provider's model service is temporarily unavailable. Retry later or select another model.
message.zh-CN: 暂时无法连接或使用该渠道的模型服务。稍后重试，或选择其他模型。

message.en-US: The phone number required for this external model could not be retrieved. Check your account's linked phone number and retry, or select another model.
message.zh-CN: 暂时无法获取使用外部模型所需的手机号。检查账号绑定信息后重试，或选择其他模型。

title.zh-CN: 外部模型服务暂不可用

message.en-US: This provider's model service is temporarily unavailable. Retry later or select another model.
message.zh-CN: 暂时无法连接或使用该渠道的模型服务。稍后重试，或选择其他模型。

title.zh-CN: 外部模型服务暂不可用

message.en-US: This provider's model service is temporarily unavailable. Retry later or select another model.
message.zh-CN: 暂时无法连接或使用该渠道的模型服务。稍后重试，或选择其他模型。

title.zh-CN: 外部模型服务暂不可用

message.en-US: This provider's model service is temporarily unavailable. Retry later or select another model.
message.zh-CN: 暂时无法连接或使用该渠道的模型服务。稍后重试，或选择其他模型。

message.en-US: Insufficient quota for the external model. Please purchase or top up your quota.
message.zh-CN: 外部模型可用额度不足，请购买或补充额度

message.en-US: Check that the provider is enabled and your subscription is active, then retry or select another model.
message.zh-CN: 检查对应渠道的启用与订阅状态后重试，或选择其他模型。

message.en-US: Check that the provider is enabled and your subscription is active, then retry or select another model.
message.zh-CN: 检查对应渠道的启用与订阅状态后重试，或选择其他模型。
